title: FizzBuzz Plus
description: Print 1–100: "Fizz" for multiples of 3, "Buzz" for 5, "FizzBuzz" for both.
hints: Build a string: start empty, `+=` each word that applies; if still empty, print the number.
requirements: Then extend: "Pop" for 7, "Bang" for 11 — combinations stack (21 → "FizzPop")
Let the user choose the upper limit
